entries.title: II Peter 1:1
segments: ¶Simon Peter, a bondservant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have obtained like precious faith with us by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:

entries.title: II Peter 1:2
segments: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

entries.title: II Peter 1:3
segments: as His divine power has given to us all things that [pertain] to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who called us by glory and virtue,

entries.title: II Peter 1:4
segments: by which have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, that through these you may be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption [that is] in the world through lust.

entries.title: II Peter 1:5
segments: ¶But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge,

entries.title: II Peter 1:6
segments: to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness,

entries.title: II Peter 1:7
segments: to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love.

entries.title: II Peter 1:8
segments: For if these things are yours and abound, [you will be] neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Peter 1:9
segments: For he who lacks these things is shortsighted, even to blindness, and has forgotten that he was cleansed from his old sins.

entries.title: II Peter 1:10
segments: Therefore, brethren, be even more diligent to make your call and election sure, for if you do these things you will never stumble;

entries.title: II Peter 1:11
segments: for so an entrance will be supplied to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Peter 1:12
segments: ¶For this reason I will not be negligent to remind you always of these things, though you know and are established in the present truth.

entries.title: II Peter 1:13
segments: Yes, I think it is right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding [you],

entries.title: II Peter 1:14
segments: knowing that shortly I [must] put off my tent, just as our Lord Jesus Christ showed me.

entries.title: II Peter 1:15
segments: Moreover I will be careful to ensure that you always have a reminder of these things after my decease.

entries.title: II Peter 1:16
segments: ¶For we did not follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of His majesty.

entries.title: II Peter 1:17
segments: For He received from God the Father honor and glory when such a voice came to Him from the Excellent Glory: "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

entries.title: II Peter 1:18
segments: And we heard this voice which came from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.

entries.title: II Peter 1:19
segments: ¶And so we have the prophetic word confirmed, which you do well to heed as a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts;

entries.title: II Peter 1:20
segments: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of any private interpretation,

entries.title: II Peter 1:21
segments: for prophecy never came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke [as they were] moved by the Holy Spirit.
